def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the uniform divider line.
    vertical = next((c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1), None)
    if vertical is not None:
        left = [row[:vertical] for row in grid]
        right = [row[vertical + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(vertical, w - vertical - 1)
        left = [row[-width:] for row in left]
        right = [row[:width] for row in right]
        shared = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
        base = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a == b else base for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    horizontal = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:horizontal], grid[horizontal + 1:]
    height = min(horizontal, h - horizontal - 1)
    top, bottom = top[-height:], bottom[:height]
    shared = set(sum(top, [])) & set(sum(bottom, []))
    base = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a == b else base for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
